{"notes": "Visit 1 (1:15 of 10:00). Early, so provisional. I don't know who placed which domino.

Priya: Proposed a left-facing fish with a forked tail, put the sketch on the pad and assigned strokes (herself top line, Maya bottom, Tom upper tail, Leo lower tail). Good, clear leadership and a fast start. Her top line is about 8 units long, but it's pale and not connected to the start. There's a small gap near x≈5.5, y≈9.5. She told me and the team she has the start and the top line, so I'm not sure she's noticed the gap. She is building outward from it. Follow up on whether she fixes the join.

Maya: Took the bottom line and is connected to the start (dark chain heading down-right), though it's short so far. She says she'll check the nose and tail joins. Communicates well and checks in with Priya. Watch pace, because the line only reaches about x=7.

Leo: Lower tail is down and he says he'll make the joins once the body lines arrive. He offered help on the body, which is good collaboration. The tail is far right (x≈22-28) and isolated, with a ~15-unit gap before the body. Check whether he actually helps close it.

Tom: Said nothing during my visit. An arc on the right looks like the upper tail, but I can't attribute it to him. No evidence either way yet. Ask him directly next visit.

Team risk: the top line is disconnected from the start, and about 12-15 units of body remain between the lines and the tail. Time is limited."}
